plugins.description: Run Google Ads, Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing) and ChatGPT Ads from Claude. Research keywords with live CPC and search volume, launch and optimize PPC and paid social campaigns, track ROAS, CPA, CTR and cost per lead, find wasted spend, audit conversion tracking, and write on-brand ad copy. New campaigns are created paused, and every spend change needs your approval.
